visual_inspection.method: each qa/page-N.png opened and read in full by the lane agent

pages.1: Title, DRAFT/AI-assistance status box, abstract, Section 1 with verbatim Conjecture 1 and Theorem 1, start of Section 2 (source definitions, Definition 3 quote). Text legible; sub/superscripts render; no missing glyphs.
pages.2: Adjacency equivalences, quantifiers, pivot and orbit readings; Section 3 with the full 8x8 matrix X (3.1) correctly typeset; Lemma 2 and proof; Lean extremality remark. Page ends after Section 3 (heading of Section 4 moved to page 3; no orphan).
pages.3: Section 4: Lemma 3 with (P1)-(P5), proof with slack 1/8 and eps = 1/512, proof of Theorem 1, certificate format, example certificate, rank histogram labelled diagnostic, consequence for the source strategy.
pages.4: End of consequence paragraph; Section 5: n = 4 control (5 of 6 tours), n = 5 recomputation, Table 2 observation (printed 20 and 28 vs computed 11 and 20) with double count, n = 6 and n = 7 open; Section 6 start and correspondence table rows 1-9.
pages.5: Correspondence table continuation (repeated header) with all six endpoints and Lemma/certificate rows; architecture; fidelity points (IsExtreme wording, natural subtraction, reviewer restatement); axioms and replay steps; audit (300 constants, two _unsafe_rec helpers); controls list begins.
pages.6: Controls list end; trust limits; Section 7 related work (follow-ups [3]-[6]; Laurent-Poljak via Deza-Indik as precedent, not subsumer); Section 8 status and limits; references [1]-[4].
pages.7: References [5]-[8], left-aligned; remainder of page blank (end of document). Footer present on every page.
